player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Rounds Won - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopeho sa ho kenya se fosahetseng. Tšebeliso: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Lebitso la tšimo le sa sebetseng. Masimo a sebetsang: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Likarolo tsohle tse abetsoeng li tlameha ho ba linomoro tsa bohlokoa tseo e seng negative.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: O tshwanetse ho hloma kwa bohle units {num_total_units}. Heshe ya tshohle: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Mokomanda Alpha a kenya {score_0}-{score_1} ka mora {num_rounds} mefuta!
outcome.winner_beta: Mokomanda Beta a kenya {score_1}-{score_0} ka mora {num_rounds} mefuta!
outcome.draw: Game ends in a {score_0}-{score_1} tie after {num_rounds} rounds!
